decision_conditions:
OBSERVATIONS:

Should any roads within LB Islington be used as primary routes for construction vehicles, then the impact on these roads should be assessed as part of any transport assessment and/or construction management plan.
description: Observation to adjoining Borough - The City of London on application reference 26/00784/SCOP for EIA Scoping Opinion under Regulation 15 of the Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017 for the redevelopment of the site known 133 Houndsditch EC3A 7BX. The proposed development comprises demolition of the existing building, retention of the existing basement and the construction of a new commercial building of up to 22 storeys in height of approximately 114m AOD. It is anticiated to provide approximately 46, 230m2 NIA of office floorspace (Class E) and 1220m2 of retail/community and amenity space (Class E/sui generis) with new public realm and associated works
